guardrails: Exploration may change worker-to-slot routing only; it never changes the allocator's assignment portfolio.
At most one two-worker swap may be applied per routing generation.
Both assignments must share slot role + work kind and at least strategy or objective.
The swapped route must stay within both absolute and relative routing-score regret caps.
At least one worker in the swap must still have generated-route measurement debt.
Selection is deterministic from pre-outcome routing state; realized outcomes are never used to choose the current swap.
Verification, measurement and wildcard slots are excluded from controlled swap exploration.
Active V11 claims remain locked and are never exploration candidates.
Exploration does not relax V14-V17 dispatch, presence, activation or execution controls.
An exploratory route is experimental design evidence, not a worker-quality ranking.
